citations.claim: Cart starts at edge offset x=0.5 moving outward and ends outside track
Cart just inside track one step before violation
First violating step cart exceeds 2.4m track limit

explanation: Controller with force_limit 20 fails to arrest cart drift: starting at x=0.5 with v=0.5 outward plus pole leaning outward (theta=0.2, omega=0.5), the state-feedback prioritizes pole balance over cart centering, applying only ~1.2N at violation time. Cart velocity remains ~1.4 m/s outward, so position integrates past 2.4m track end at step 68.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.424 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The blue cart drifts progressively rightward toward the edge of the track from steps 65 to 68 while the pole stays nearly upright. At step 68 the cart reaches the far right end with the red violation marker under it.
